criteria.requirement: Add markdown.results.convert_document(text,extensions=(),extension_configs=None,**options) and frozen ConversionResult(html,toc,toc_tokens,metadata,references). Use a fresh real Markdown instance for each decoded-text call and capture actual extension-produced fields with deep copied result containers. Without extensions return explicit empty fields. Later documents or caller mutation of returned containers cannot change earlier/later result snapshots; opaque extension objects retain their normal documented lifecycle and are not falsely claimed clonable. Preserve existing markdown()/Markdown.convert APIs, registered extension behavior, output-format options and actual reference tuples. No invented source-position/diagnostic data or model calls.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
